workflows.name: Vertical-slice feature plan
workflows.description: Decompose a behavior change into end-to-end slices, each verifiable alone; wide mechanical changes go expand -> migrate -> contract.
workflows.trigger: PLAN_WRITE for a feature or change that touches more than one layer (data, logic, API, UI) or renames/retypes something used in many places

steps.action: List the observable behaviors the change adds or alters, smallest useful one first
steps.success_criteria: Each behavior is stated as something a test or manual check can observe
steps.fallback: Ask the user which behavior matters first

steps.action: For each behavior, one step that goes through every layer it touches, with the test that proves it named before the code (one RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle per behavior)
steps.success_criteria: Every step names its own verifying test and is shippable alone
steps.fallback: A step with no standalone check is merged into its neighbour or split differently

steps.action: For a rename/retype/library swap too wide for one green slice: expand (add new form beside old), migrate call sites in batches, contract (remove old form)
steps.success_criteria: Build and tests are green after every batch
steps.fallback: A red batch is reverted and re-split smaller

steps.action: Execute one slice at a time
steps.success_criteria: Each slice's test passes before the next starts
steps.fallback: Stop and re-plan the remaining slices

workflow.name: string — human-readable name
workflow.trigger: string — when to use this workflow

steps.success_criteria: string — how to verify this step worked
steps.fallback: string — what to do if this step fails

workflow.learned_from: string — session or context where this was learned
workflow.success_count: number — how many times this workflow has been successfully executed
workflow.pinned: boolean — reserved for a future forgetting/pruning policy for this file, which does not exist yet (core.memory.sk has none defined) — currently always false, has no effect
workflow.stock: boolean — true only for a workflow shipped with the framework. UPDATE_PROMPT.md Step 2 matches stock entries by id on upgrade, adds missing ones and offers changed ones (never replaces a user-edited entry without asking, keeps success_count/last_used); absent or false for anything the project saved itself
workflow.project_only: boolean — true only for a workflow specific to this repo's own dev process, never meant for a project that installs the framework; absent or false for a normal reusable workflow. INSTALL_PROMPT.md Step 4 strips any project_only:true entry on fresh install (EP-75) — same treatment RELEASE/EVOLVE_BENCHMARK already get as commands

notes: Written by core.planning.sk's PLAN_EXECUTE step 7 (EP-74), only when a completed plan's step sequence is a genuinely repeatable pattern, not one-off work — offered to the user, never saved silently. Read by PLAN_WRITE step 1 (match on `trigger` before drafting a new plan from scratch, bump `success_count`/`last_used` on reuse).
